s00014.summary: Judge Fairweather admits the manifest as both counsel agree in unison
The Judge wearily prepares to adjourn the quiet morning for lunch
Lieutenant Arroyo interrupts carrying a newly found engine room log as evidence
The Judge confronts Percy with his signature in the engineer's log
De Luca and Osei clash over the ambush evidence until the Judge restores order
Percy whispers to De Luca, who goes pale and asks about Annabelle

s00002.summary: Tamsin browses humming books in the flooded library as Bram works and twins play
Seraph Vane arrives asking for the keeper; Tamsin quietly returns the humming book

s01052.summary: Sleepless Tamara replays her own identical daily log recordings in the cramped capsule
Tamara takes out a creased photograph, then puts it back without looking
She loops the recordings obsessively, then lets the recorder drift and touches the porthole
Recording a new entry, Tamara cannot bring herself to say morale is fine

s01094.summary: Helena finds a hidden journal beneath the telescope and reads its warning
Grant scolds Helena by phone for going without backup and warns her
Helena spots fresh footprints and follows them to a half-open door
A Tall Man holding a brass key steps out of the darkness
Helena questions Warrick's former student about the death and the star
The dome closes, Helena hurls the journal and the Tall Man lunges into darkness

s00000.summary: The flooded roller rink serves as courtroom; Adaeze stands alone, Lev too calm
Lev sneers that the absent client's hospitalization is convenient; Adaeze bristles
They bicker over the unreceived doctor's note until the Judge demands silence
Lev moves to proceed in absentia citing a waiver signed Monday
Adaeze finds the signature, insists it is forged, and accuses Lev at the bench
Judge Tran rubs the signature and finds the ink still wet
Lev flails for excuses about a re-signing as the Judge presses
A clerk appears with the felt-tip pen and confesses Lev called it routine
The Judge seats Lev and grants Adaeze's motion for dismissal with prejudice
Adaeze exhales and credits her sneakers; the Judge adjourns over tea

s01024.summary: Hartmann interrupts Oyelaran's exhibit, objecting the contract was never signed
The litigants trade accusations of forgery and hidden originals as Vance shouts order
Vance splinters her gavel and orders both to sit down

s01102.summary: On a chair in the flooding tent, Marisol tries to address unheeding guests
Water pours in; three guests dive for the cake and land in the mud
Marisol laughs, toasts the wettest wedding, and jumps into Adebayo's arms

s01091.summary: The Courier holds Hayes at gunpoint and orders the agents to drop weapons
Irina whispers a plan to Kofi to draw the Courier away from Hayes
A coin distraction, a shot, and Irina charges into a brawl with the Courier
Kofi seizes the gun and the Courier surrenders to be cuffed
Freed Hayes reveals the Courier was warning him about the Directorate
They hustle everyone to the stairwell as enemy headlights sweep in

s01041.summary: Fishers chat about the cold in a cozy ice shanty with newcomer Brigid
Teddy hooks a fish that fights and escapes, leaving him laughing
The group settles into a peaceful quiet as snow ticks on the roof
Brigid asks about the groaning ice; Teddy hears humming, the adults dismiss it eerily
Ansel wakes and urgently warns no one to put a hand in the hole
A pale hand rises from the water and takes Teddy's mitten; heater dies

s01027.summary: Tearful Dezi sits in the empty rink while a boy watches her
The boy teases her skating; she answers with dry heartbreak humor
He raises the rumor she took her mother's car and introduces himself as Junior
Dezi falls hard, screams and laughs, and Junior slides over to join her
They share their anger at parents and Dezi admits she just wanted escape
Lights blaze; Ms. Fairweather finds them, offers coffee, and tells Dezi to call home
Dezi glances at Junior and begins unlacing her skates

s00004.summary: A riverboat deposition assembles with genial Neely, attorney Horace, and counsel Miles
Neely plays at friendly informality while Miles insists on formality
Horace gently asks about ownership, capacity and sprinklers over Miles's objections
Horace turns to the engine room fire and the door locked from outside
Horace produces the signed work order for an exterior bolt from the dead contractor
Neely begs Miles to intervene; Miles flounders for a recess
Neely admits the room was meant to be empty for the insurance fire
Horace finally uncaps his pen, writes one line, and ends the session

s00008.summary: June claims to be doing maintenance at 2 a.m. to the skeptical guard
June slips into her headset and explains away roof hatch as roof catch
Wallace shares his late wife's joke about Orion and June genuinely laughs
June signals her crew to hold and claims she is praying for her laptop
Wallace reveals he knew about the heist all along and stayed on break
He offers her coffee and asks the crew to leave the telescope

s01023.summary: The cannery line stops for a breaker; Paulina calls a ten-minute break
Desmond shows Gus a video of his niece, earning a real smile
A soft tapping starts from the live tank, unnoticed while they chat
Paulina asks who is tapping; Gus notes the water is not moving
Paulina approaches the tank and finds a human hand pressed to the glass
Gus's own face drifts up in the tank while Gus grins too wide; lights die

pd_dollhouse_4.summary: Mrs Linde urges Nora to delay Helmer while she seeks Krogstad, then leaves
Nora calls Helmer, who enters with Rank expecting to see her costume
Nora pleads helplessness and makes Helmer promise his whole evening to her
Helmer heads to check the letters and Nora desperately begs him not to
Nora plays the Tarantella to stop him and begs him to rehearse
Nora dances wildly with the tambourine as Helmer plays and Rank watches

s00012.summary: Tired Birgitta does laundry with Tobias while a lone girl reads nearby
Tobias wheedles gummies from his mother, correcting her on the time
Tobias offers the Girl his dinosaur Gary; she deflates his claims
Birgitta asks after the Girl's parents and notices the empty lot
Birgitta offers to call for help and Noor anxiously begs her not to
A breathless man bangs in; Birgitta shields the children
Noor runs to her father, who explains and thanks Birgitta; goodbyes

s01095.summary: A sheriff, widow and boy stand over a fresh grave in a dusty pen
Augustine offers condolence and help with the horse; Abigail declines
Abigail sets the hat on the cross and weights it with a stone
Augustine offers a paper she refuses; he buries it unread by the cross
Jeremiah takes his mother's hand and they watch the cross at sunset

s01061.summary: Gregor rallies vest-clad employees with platitudes as the escape room clock ticks
The team bickers over a vague clue while Marcus anxiously counts down
Delilah points out the answer written on the whiteboard behind Gregor
The chest opens to reveal only a survey card with a QR code

s01036.summary: Agnes hems Delphine's gown as the bride avoids her reflection
Colonel Ashby-Grey arrives unannounced insisting the wedding is Saturday
He orders a tighter bodice; she'll not need to breathe
Delphine asks Yusuf how far and long a journey to Damascus would be
Ashby-Grey grows suspicious; Agnes signals Delphine, then covers her slip
The Colonel studies them, sets the hour, and leaves; Delphine steps down

s01089.summary: In a church field hospital Siobhan has Teddy search the radio bands
The radio reports enemy withdrawal; Siobhan cautions it's only over tonight
Siobhan checks Oswin's pulse and tucks his blanket up
Rosalind checks Mikhail's wound and they joke quietly about his wife
The ceasefire is announced; everyone absorbs it in exhausted relief
Siobhan folds the bloody altar sheet and lays it on the stone
Siobhan sends everyone to rest and takes first watch by the candle

s01100.summary: The crew tends the greenhouse ring while Halcyon reports and Iris stares
Waldemar quietly asks if the brooding commander is okay
Iris announces a six-month mission extension and delayed rotation
Iris talks tomatoes; the crew exchange resigned looks
Iris orders four teas; Halcyon notes only three, and her smile fades
Iris walks away; Waldemar asks who the fourth was

s01101.summary: Luciana pushes Dorian to revive the dead console in the dim bay
Imani hears rhythmic tapping; Esperanza identifies it as a countdown
Comms reaches Luciana claiming to be locked crew tapping on the hull
Comms says they are not in bay four; the tapping isn't theirs
The light dies and a thin voice laughs from the vent

pd_dollhouse_6.summary: Helmer insists he can change; Nora fetches her things to go
Helmer begs her to wait or live as siblings; Nora dresses to leave
Nora says goodbye, frees him from obligations and exchanges rings
Helmer asks to write or help her; Nora refuses everything from a stranger
Nora names the miracle a real marriage would need, then leaves
Helmer grieves her absence, hopes briefly, and hears the door shut
